resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register places the 1917 ground house just north of the present structure. The 2020 hiking write-up says the lookout stood on the real Duncan Peak until 1941. The accounts do not match, and the write-up is a hiking blog, so the story reports the register and flags the blog as unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Dates and design come from the register alone; the record's 1943 build year matches it. Staffing is from a 2023 Forest Service feature and may be out of date; no later staffing record was found. Access is thin: no rental listing and no Forest Service visiting page was read. The access level is unknown, not public: the only access evidence is a 2020 hiking trip report, and no source read says whether the cab is open to visitors. The fire camera project page: search snippets reported two versions, one showing the project in progress and one completed; I read only the version with the May 16, 2025 decision date and could not confirm installation. The blog's account of the earlier station is unverified. The register's photos are all rights reserved, so none were added.
